description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - Duties & Functions assigned to the State Minister of International Trade
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade) and provides a detailed schedule outlining the specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, and laws assigned to the State Minister of International Trade. It contains both the "who" (a named government person) and the "what" (detailed responsibilities and portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
